title: PRP
caption: PRP uses your own blood to deliver a concentrated dose of growth factors exactly where your skin or scalp needs them. A small blood draw is spun in a centrifuge to separate the platelet-rich plasma, which is then injected or microneedled into the target area. The growth factors signal tissue to repair and regenerate — not add volume, not relax a muscle. That distinction matters: PRP is a biological stimulus, not a filler and not a toxin. Knowing that tells you what kind of result to realistically expect, and how long it takes to see it. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
